gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8205 handtools n.e.s.; chapter 82 note 1 covers articles with a base-metal working part
GRI 6: 8205.59 other, 8205.59.55 other of iron or steel, .10 other (edged handtools)

rejected_alternatives.reason: sets of tools from two or more of headings 8202-8205 only; description is not clearly a retail set
interchangeable tools for machine tools, not hand tools

classification.rationale: Clay cutting and modeling tools are handtools with base-metal working parts not specified elsewhere, heading 8205. CBP ruling M83095 (in force) classified a pottery tool set with wire clay cutter and scrapers in 8205.59.5510. Wooden or plastic modeling tools would fall elsewhere, hence moderate confidence.
